changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientservicesandproducts AS SELECT psp.id, psp.patient_id, psp.encounter_id, psp.billing_item_type, psp.brand_medication_id, psp.diagnostic_test_id, psp.service_id, psp.procedure_id, psp.service_source, psp.source_id, psp.quantity, psp.unit_price, psp.discount_amount, psp.exemption_amount, psp.tax_amount, psp.total_amount, psp.currency, psp.is_billed, psp.billing_invoice_id, psp.billing_invoice_item_id, psp.notes, psp.created_by, psp.created_date, psp.last_modified_by, psp.last_modified_date, psp.pre_authorization_status, psp.payment_id, psp.payment_type, psp.payment_status, psp.coverage_status, psp.not_covered_reason, psp.patient_insurance_id, psp.price_source, psp.is_default_service, psp.is_exempted, psp.gross_amount, psp.net_amount, psp.patient_share_amount, psp.insurance_share_amount, psp.paid_amount, psp.remaining_amount, psp.waseel_sbs_mapping_id, psp.waseel_sbs_code, psp.pre_authorization_required, psp.pre_authorization_request_id, psp.pre_authorization_reference_no FROM public.patient_services_and_products psp;
